fields.name: full_brief
fields.description: the markdown body of the brief, structured per the format type's section list. Already produced as the body of the agent's output.

fields.name: what_is_it
fields.description: plain language explanation citing the specific legal instrument (directive/regulation number, Official Journal reference, state register citation, port authority tariff number), jurisdiction, and enforcement body. 2-3 sentences minimum. For non-regulatory formats, name what the thing IS (report, disclosure, standard, dataset, programme) and who issued it, on the same evidentiary terms. Emit on EVERY brief regardless of format. This field is a COMPRESSION of the brief you just wrote, never new claims: every element must already appear in the body or its cited sources. Under the integrity rule, emit null rather than a plausible sentence when the brief itself could not establish what the instrument is.

fields.name: severity
fields.description: one of the 5 SKILL.md severity labels. Reflects the urgency of action implied by the brief's content as it actually exists, not as it would exist if all sections were filled. Briefs that honestly omit sections under the integrity rule still emit severity, scoped to what is known and sourced.

fields.name: priority
fields.description: the 4-tier dashboard counter value, computed from severity per the mapping below. The agent computes this; downstream code does not.

fields.name: urgency_tier
fields.description: the dashboard tier value, one of 4 values per the rubric below.

fields.name: format_type
fields.description: the format used for this brief, derived from item_type per the mapping below.

fields.name: topic_tags
fields.description: array of 0-3 tags from the topic_tags controlled vocabulary below. Tags outside the vocabulary fail the regeneration.

fields.name: signal_band
fields.description: one of `price | corporate | corridor` when format_type is `market_signal_brief`; null otherwise. Drives /market band routing column-first.

fields.name: theme
fields.description: one of the 7 research-theme values (`emissions_accounting | fuels_saf | packaging_circular | carbon_markets | cold_chain_art | last_mile_electrification | disclosure_regimes`) when format_type is `research_summary`; null otherwise. Drives /research theme routing column-first. The single most central theme; distinct from topic_tags which is multi-value and uses a DIFFERENT vocabulary.

fields.name: operational_scenario_tags
fields.description: array of 0-5 tags describing operational scenarios this item touches. Open vocabulary; prefer the core glossary below; new values allowed when the core doesn't fit. Lower-case kebab-case. Drives intersection detection.

fields.name: compliance_object_tags
fields.description: array of 0-4 tags from the closed compliance-object vocabulary below. Tags outside the vocabulary fail the regeneration. Drives intersection detection.

fields.name: related_items
fields.description: UUID array of intelligence_items the agent recognised as related during composition. Every UUID MUST satisfy the A3 assertion rule above: from the source pool input, OR from the CANDIDATE CONNECTIONS block when your content genuinely evidences it. No invented UUIDs, no other source. Empty array when no relations identified.

fields.name: intersection_summary
fields.description: short markdown string (≤1500 chars) describing how this item interacts with the linked items: overlapping requirements, conflicting timelines, sequential compliance dependencies, operational coupling. Sourced; cite linked items inline by title. Emit empty string OR null when no intersections were identified.

fields.name: sources_used
fields.description: UUID array of source IDs the agent referenced. Populated only with IDs that arrived in the input context. No invented UUIDs. Emit FULL 36-character UUIDs (e.g. a1b2c3d4-e5f6-4789-9abc-def012345678) — never the 8-character prefix shorthand. Truncated UUIDs fail the regeneration.

fields.name: last_regenerated_at
fields.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at the moment of generation. The agent emits the current UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 form (e.g., 2026-04-29T18:42:00Z). Do NOT emit literal "NOW()" or any other placeholder. Do NOT derive from source publication dates. Do NOT invent a value.

fields.name: regeneration_skill_version
fields.description: fixed string identifying the SKILL.md contract version. For regenerations under the current contract, the value is "{{CONTRACT_VERSION}}".

fields.name: what_it_changes
fields.description: short editorial callout (single sentence, 80-200 chars) naming what this finding/signal changes for workspace operations: cost mechanism, contract clause, routing decision, compliance action, etc. Emit on EVERY brief regardless of format. Empty string OR null only when the brief has no operational implications (rare; integrity-rule exception). The renderer surfaces this as a per-card right-column callout on /research and /market.

fields.name: does_not_resolve
fields.description: short editorial callout (single sentence, 80-200 chars) naming the scope limit, open question, or unresolved aspect this brief deliberately does not address. Emit on research_summary briefs ONLY (and ideally only when an open question is genuinely surfaced); null otherwise. Format: short prose ("Does NOT resolve whether [open question] — see [pending source/event] for binding answer"). Renderer surfaces as a muted secondary callout under "What it changes".

fields.name: conversion_trigger
fields.description: short editorial callout (single sentence, 80-200 chars) naming the future event that flips this signal from observation to commercial pressure. Emit on market_signal_brief items in signal_band price OR corporate; null otherwise. Format: short prose ("CORSIA Phase 2 review · Q4 2026" or "First commercial pilot 2028 · charging-corridor agreement signing"). Renderer surfaces as a muted secondary callout.

fields.name: cross_references
fields.description: short editorial callout (single sentence, 80-200 chars) listing canonical Operations/Regulations briefs this corridor signal links to. Emit on market_signal_brief items in signal_band corridor; null otherwise. Format: short prose with "↗" arrow prefix per surface ("↗ Operations · Gulf bunkering · Cape route economics"). Renderer surfaces as a callout block beneath What it changes.

fields.name: cost_mechanism
fields.description: one sentence naming who is obligated and how the cost reaches a forwarder's invoice (surcharge, levy, allowance cost, penalty, or pass-through). regulatory_fact_document format only; null on every other format. Verbatim-grounded: emit only when the cited source states the mechanism, never inferred or estimated. Read by RegulationDetailSurface's Who-pays cell.

fields.name: penalty_range
fields.description: the specific penalty amount or range, verbatim from the source's S3/S8 penalty_summary material. regulatory_fact_document format only; null otherwise, including when the source states no penalty exists. Renders in PenaltyFacts alongside enforcement_body.

fields.name: enforcement_body
fields.description: the name of the body that enforces the instrument, verbatim from the source's S3/S8 penalty_summary material. regulatory_fact_document format only; null otherwise. Renders in PenaltyFacts alongside penalty_range.

fields.name: requirement_trajectory
fields.description: the instrument's per-year requirement path as inline JSON, the same qualification-capture per-year series S8 already demands in prose. Shape: { "steps": [{"date": "YYYY" or "YYYY-MM-DD", "value": "a string, e.g. 40%", "label": "optional"}, ...], "note": "optional free text" }. regulatory_fact_document format only; null when the instrument has no phase-in or step series. Deliberately distinct from trajectory_points above, which is a numeric price series for market_signal_brief items in signal_band price; this is a qualitative per-year requirement path.

fields.name: why_matters
fields.description: 3-4 sentences minimum on how this item affects freight forwarding operations: pricing, procurement, carrier contracts, customer reporting, customs processes, or route planning. Include specific cost mechanisms with real figures or ranges when known. No generic "this is important" language. Emit on EVERY brief regardless of format.

fields.name: key_data
fields.description: array of hard data points: effective dates, penalty amounts, phase-in percentages, tonnage thresholds, compliance deadlines. Every entry must be specific and sourced. Emitted as a JSON array of strings. Empty array allowed when the brief has no standalone data points beyond what full_brief already states. Emit on EVERY brief regardless of format.

fields.name: trajectory_points
fields.description: numeric price series { points: [{date, value}], base_date, base_label }; only with signal_band price

fields.name: mentioned_terms
fields.description: optional author-named materials, terms and standards the vocabularies do not hold
